__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus datasource for Jenkins & Kubernetes metrics

description: Full-stack Jenkins on K8s monitoring: JVM, build SLOs, container health, agent fleet, GC deep-dive, and security. Default namespace: jenkins. | v2-fixed: JVM namespace label removed, rate intervals updated, build-metric dual-prefix fallbacks added, pod regex fixed.

targets.expr:
100 * (
  (rate(jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or rate(default_jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0))
  /
  clamp_min(
    (rate(jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or rate(default_jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0))
    + (rate(jenkins_builds_failed_builds_total[$__rate_interval])  or rate(default_jenkins_builds_failed_builds_total[$__rate_interval])  or vector(0))
    + (rate(jenkins_builds_unstable_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or rate(default_jenkins_builds_unstable_builds_total[$__rate_interval]) or vector(0))
    + (rate(jenkins_builds_aborted_builds_total[$__rate_interval])  or rate(default_jenkins_builds_aborted_builds_total[$__rate_interval])  or vector(0)),
    0.001
  )
) or vector(0)

panels.title: 📈 Build Results — Stacked (Success / Failed / Unstable / Aborted)
🖥️ K8s CPU Usage vs Request vs Limit
💾 K8s Memory Usage vs Request vs Limit
⚡ CPU Throttling % (Throttled / Total Periods)
panels.description: High throttling means the CPU limit is too low — pods are being CPU-starved.

panels.title: 💿 Container Disk I/O (Read / Write)
panels.description: Container filesystem read/write throughput. High write rates can indicate log flooding or workspace bloat.

panels.title: 💀 OOM Kill Events (last 1h)
panels.description: Count of containers terminated by OOMKiller. Increase memory limits if non-zero.

panels.title: ⚠️ Pods Not Running
panels.description: Number of pods in Pending / Failed / Unknown phase in the namespace.

panels.title: 🗄️ Container FS Usage
panels.description: Total filesystem bytes consumed by containers.

panels.title: 🔴 Network Errors / sec
panels.description: Total TX + RX network errors per second. Non-zero usually indicates CNI or MTU issues.

panels.title: 🔄 Container Restart Rate (Trend)
panels.description: Container restart rate over time. Persistent restarts indicate CrashLoopBackOff — check logs.

panels.title: 🎯 Build SLO — Success Rate (24h)
panels.description: Rolling 24-hour build success rate SLO. Target: ≥95% success.

targets.expr:
100 * (
  (sum(increase(jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[24h])) or sum(increase(default_jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[24h])) or vector(0))
  /
  clamp_min(
    (sum(increase(jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[24h])) or sum(increase(default_jenkins_builds_success_builds_total[24h])) or vector(0))
    + (sum(increase(jenkins_builds_failed_builds_total[24h]))   or sum(increase(default_jenkins_builds_failed_builds_total[24h]))   or vector(0))
    + (sum(increase(jenkins_builds_unstable_builds_total[24h])) or sum(increase(default_jenkins_builds_unstable_builds_total[24h])) or vector(0))
    + (sum(increase(jenkins_builds_aborted_builds_total[24h]))  or sum(increase(default_jenkins_builds_aborted_builds_total[24h]))  or vector(0)),
    0.001
  )
) or vector(0)

panels.title: 📈 7-Day Build Trend (Hourly Rollup)
panels.description: Stacked hourly build counts over the last 7 days. Use a 7d time range in Grafana to get the full picture.

panels.title: ⏱ Avg Build Duration (last 1h)
panels.description: Average build duration in last 1h. Yellow > 5 min, Red > 10 min.

panels.title: 📏 P95 Build Duration (last 1h)
panels.description: 95th percentile build duration. Red > 30 min indicates slow pipeline.

panels.title: 🔴 JVM Heap Pressure %
panels.description: JVM heap utilisation as % of max heap (-Xmx). Red > 85% → risk of OOM / GC pauses.

panels.title: ♻️ GC Memory Allocation & Promotion Rate
panels.description: High allocation rate with high promotion rate indicates memory pressure and potential GC storms.

panels.title: 📚 JVM Class Loading
panels.description: Number of loaded JVM classes. A growing trend without decreases may indicate a class loader leak.

panels.title: 🗂 JVM Buffer Pools (Direct / Mapped)
panels.description: Direct and mapped NIO buffer pool usage. High direct buffer usage may indicate I/O intensive operations.

panels.title: ⏰ GC Pause Duration Breakdown (all causes)
panels.description: GC pause duration percentiles broken down by GC action and cause. Long STW pauses (>200ms) affect Jenkins responsiveness.

panels.title: 🤖 Agent — Executor Utilisation Over Time
panels.description: Jenkins master executor pool utilisation over time. When In-Use ≈ Total, builds start queuing.

panels.title: 🖥️ Agent Node Online vs Offline Trend
panels.description: Jenkins node health over time. Offline nodes reduce build capacity and may trigger queue build-up.

panels.title: 🔌 Plugin Health Over Time (Active / Failed)
panels.description: Plugin status trend. Failed plugins may break pipelines or expose security vulnerabilities.

panels.title: 🔴 Offline Agent Nodes
panels.description: Number of Jenkins agent nodes currently offline.

panels.title: ⏳ Pending Builds
panels.description: Total builds waiting to start (queued + blocked).
